integrity: Exact integer Smith/Hermite arithmetic, explicit mod-two permutation-module proof, and a standalone source-independent verifier; classical Segre geometry imported from the cited primary literature.
scientific_limitations: Good characteristic at least 5; only the abstract node-plane incidence cokernel and its finite-field Frobenius coinvariants. No Picard, Chow, Brauer, or full threefold cohomology identification. An equivalent combinatorial design Smith calculation may exist elsewhere, and historical priority is not independently established.
title: Integral Frobenius coinvariants of the Segre cubic node–plane incidence
